meta.topic: Clothing gaps: fit departments (petite, tall, plus, maternity, adaptive), clothing subtypes (swim, shapewear, hosiery, slips, thermals, cultural), fit charts (rings, jeans waist x inseam, hips), garment and shoe repair, one product at several sellers, parcel tracking stages, resale fees
meta.method: Read on 2026-10-03 from each publisher's own pages or the JSON those pages load: Uniqlo commerce API (/api/commerce/v5, x-fr-clientid uq.<market>.web-spa) for US/UK/CA; Spanx Shopify products.json (www.spanx.com); Gap Inc. search API (api.gap.com/commerce/search/v2/product_listings) for Old Navy, Gap and Banana Republic US/CA; Marks & Spencer category pages' __NEXT_DATA__; Arnotts and Brown Thomas search pages' data-gtm product data; Liverpool search pages' embedded records; nike.com __NEXT_DATA__ per country; carrier help pages (USPS, Canada Post, FedEx UK); repair shops' own price pages; Nordstrom's shoe-repair PDF; H.Samuel's ring chart; Levi's help-centre size guide; Target corporate and Target size-chart fragment. Where a publisher's page refused automated reads (403 or bot wall: Tommy Hilfiger, Aritzia, Levi's.com, Converse, Primark corporate, Royal Mail, UPS, An Post, The RealReal, Macy's, Nordstrom.com, Next, John Lewis, Simons, El Palacio de Hierro), figures come from a search engine's summary and are confirmed:false with a note. Nothing is estimated.

priceConventions.spanx: price = the price the Shopify variant carried on 2026-10-03; compareAtPrice = the struck-through regular price where Spanx showed one (null means price is the regular price). USD before sales tax.
priceConventions.gapInc: regularPrice = the colour's regularPrice; currentPrice = its effectivePrice; priceType R = regular, P = promotion, M = markdown. US before sales tax; CA before GST/HST.
priceConventions.liverpool: listPrice = Liverpool's list price; promoPrice = the price after the promotion running on 2026-10-03 (equal to listPrice when none). MXN with IVA included. Product URLs follow https://www.liverpool.com.mx/tienda/pdp/<slug>/<productId>; the slug is not checked (one URL with an arbitrary slug resolved to the right product).
priceConventions.arnottsBrownThomas: price = the price in the tile's data-gtm; where isSale is true it is the sale price, not the regular one. EUR with VAT.
priceConventions.marksAndSpencer: price = the first variant's price in the category page data; GBP with VAT. It can be a markdown (the 7.19 bikini top looks like one) and the category data carries no regular/sale flag.
priceConventions.uniqlo: price = prices.base.value from Uniqlo's commerce API (regular price; promo was null for every item listed).

statuses: Shipping Label Created, USPS Awaiting Item
Pre-Shipment Info Sent to USPS, USPS Awaiting Item
Picked Up by / Arrived at / Departed Shipping Partner Facility, USPS Awaiting Item
stages.meaning: A label exists with a tracking number but USPS does not yet have the package (or a shipping partner is bringing it); a delivery date appears once USPS receives it.
Being processed or transported to the delivering Post Office; scans can repeat at one facility or over several days.

statuses: Held at Post Office, At Customer Request
stages.meaning: Out for Delivery: prepared at the local Post Office and will be delivered by a carrier today; if not delivered one full postal business day after this scan, the customer may file a service request.

Delivered has a recorded date, time and location. No Access: automatic reattempt next business day. Notice Left for a signature item: no automatic second attempt; schedule redelivery, collect with photo ID, or return to sender. Insufficient Address / No Such Number: returned to sender.

figures.note: money-back guarantee; delivers 7 days a week

stages.meaning: The shipper printed the label and is preparing to hand the package to FedEx.
Arrived at a FedEx-approved facility or picked up by a FedEx courier.
Moving toward its destination, in a vehicle or at a FedEx facility.
Safe at a FedEx-approved location; status updates when it moves again.
Scanned and placed on a vehicle for delivery that day.
Delivery date or address changed, by shipper/recipient request or exceptional events.
Delayed; likely to miss the original estimate.
Turned away at delivery (e.g. damaged, recipient unable to pay a delivery fee); FedEx contacts the shipper.
Canada Post has received the package and it is en route.
On its way to its final destination.

Could not be delivered (won't fit, community mailbox full, no one to receive and no safe drop approved, 'Card for pickup' chosen, too large for PO box); sent to a post office for pickup with Delivery Notice Card and government photo ID.

stages.status: Delivery Attempt Made / Rescheduled for delivery next business day
stages.meaning: Attempt failed; normally retried the next business day.
Addressing error being verified; if unverifiable, returned to sender and the return cannot be stopped.
Delivery interrupted; an arrow at the end of the bar means returned to sender.
Under customs review, standard for international packages.
Royal Mail has the shipment information or has taken the item in.
Moving through the network; can sit on this status for a day or two.
With the postman for delivery today.
Delivered.

timings.aim: 2-3 working days (two days for over 94% of postcodes)

tracking.note: royalmail.com and help.royalmail.com returned 403. Status wording from a third-party summary (pango.ai), timings from a search summary of Royal Mail's pages.

stages.meaning: Shipper created a label and sent details to UPS; UPS does not have the package yet.
Picked up and moving through the UPS network between facilities.
Assigned to a driver for delivery that day; residential deliveries typically 9 a.m.-7 p.m.

tracking.note: ups.com returned Access Denied; from third-party summaries (lateshipment.com).

stages.meaning: An Post has the sender's information but may not yet have the item; a tracking update follows when the item arrives.
Sorted and on its way to the address.
